name: Barbell Pullover to Press
steps: Lie flat on a bench with feet planted firmly and hold a barbell shoulder-width apart above your chest with softly bent elbows.
Lower the bar smoothly in an arc behind your head until you feel a controlled lat stretch.
Pull the bar forward over your chest and bend your elbows to bring it gently down to your lower chest.
Press the bar straight back up until your arms extend above your shoulders.
tips: Keep the bar clear of your head and face during the transition from pullover to press.
Keep your ribs down and shoulder blades anchored on the bench throughout both phases.
